responsibility: This file implements GCC’s XML tree serialization and builder behavior used by diagnostics and related host-side output. It defines XML escaping, pretty-printer based emission for documents, elements, text, comments, and raw fragments, child/attribute management on tree nodes, and the operational methods of `xml::printer` for nested incremental construction. Under `CHECKING_P` it also implements XML selftests and the `assert_xml_print_eq` helper. Its role is the executable implementation of GCC’s lightweight in-memory XML model and printer.
same_name_distinction: Implements the behaviors declared by `xml.h`: XML escaping, serialization via `write_as_xml`, child and attribute mutation, and the incremental `xml::printer` operations, plus `CHECKING_P` selftests. Unlike `xml.h`, it is the executable writer/builder implementation rather than the node type declarations.
